title: 课程导论：数据结构、模块与问题集
titleEn: Course Intro: Data Structures, Modules, and Problem Sets

items.text: 经典数据结构如平衡二叉搜索树和 Python 字典历经数十年仍有用；本课程会以不同方式扩展它们以适配特定问题。
items.textEn: Classic data structures like balanced binary search trees and Python dictionaries still matter; we will augment them.

items.text: 本课重在分析而非大量设计算法；若喜欢可继续修 6.046《算法设计与分析》。
items.textEn: You will analyze more than design; take 6.046 for deeper algorithm design.

items.text: 每个问题集都包含理论部分与 Python 编程实现；“有趣”指有挑战且值得，不是简单。
items.textEn: Each problem set mixes theory and Python implementation; fun means challenging, not easy.

items.text: 课程共 8 个模块，每个模块大致对应一个 problem set。
items.textEn: There are eight modules, each roughly tied to one problem set.

items.text: 模块一为算法思维，今天讲 peak finding；发放的 Python 代码中有些含 bug，需要分析复杂度、判断正确与高效，并为其中一个写证明。
items.textEn: Module 1: algorithmic thinking and peak finding; given Python code has bugs; analyze complexity, test efficiency/correctness, and write one proof.

items.text: 模块二讲排序与树：若要对一万亿个数排序该用什么算法；用某种排序算法/数据结构模拟逻辑网络是第二个 problem set。
items.textEn: Module 2: sorting and trees; trillion-number sorting; simulate a logic network using a sorting/data structure.

items.text: 模块三讲哈希，应用于基因组比较：人类与老鼠基因组约 99% 相似；复杂度不够低时大输入程序跑不完。
items.textEn: Module 3: hashing; genome comparison human vs rat were about 99% similar; low complexity is essential or large inputs won't finish.
